verdict.rationale: The only governance signals are indirect: the official repository lives under the facebook GitHub organization (react-gh-1), and community threads describe Facebook unilaterally setting and then changing React's license from BSD+Patents to MIT (react-comm-4, react-comm-9). Together these imply single-company stewardship, but nothing in the pack states React's governance model outright. missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement of the governance model (foundation vs. company), documentation of steering or decision-making structure, any continuity or transfer commitments, and independent corroboration of the current governance status.
